definitions.explanation: Insects or other organisms that damage crops, gardens, or stored products, or that spread disease.

examples.japanese: {害虫|がいちゅう}{駆除|くじょ}の{業者|ぎょうしゃ}を{呼|よ}ぶ。
examples.english: To call a pest control company.

examples.japanese: {農作物|のうさくぶつ}を{害虫|がいちゅう}から{守|まも}る。
{害虫|がいちゅう}が{大量|たいりょう}{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: There was a major pest outbreak.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {害|がい} (harm, damage) + {虫|ちゅう} (insect). Literally "harmful insect."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{害虫|がいちゅう}{駆除|くじょ} (pest extermination)
・{害虫|がいちゅう}{対策|たいさく} (pest control measures)
・{害虫|がいちゅう}が{発生|はっせい}する (pests appear/emerge)
・{害虫|がいちゅう}{被害|ひがい} (pest damage)
・{農業|のうぎょう}{害虫|がいちゅう} (agricultural pests)

COMMON PESTS IN JAPAN:
・アブラムシ (aphid)
・{毛虫|けむし} (caterpillar)
・ウンカ (planthopper - rice pest)
・ゴキブリ (cockroach - household pest)
・シロアリ (termite)

CONTRAST:
・{害虫|がいちゅう}: pest, harmful insect
・{益虫|えきちゅう}: beneficial insect (e.g., ladybugs, bees)

RELATED TERMS:
・{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい} (insecticide)
・{農薬|のうやく} (pesticide, agricultural chemicals)
・{防虫|ぼうちゅう} (insect repellent/prevention)
